[[File:Mr Cheeves.png|thumb|250px|Mr. Cheeves]] '''Mr. Cheeves''' (Japanese: '''管理人''' ''Estate Manager'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP002|Two Degrees of Separation!]]'', as [[James]]'s butler. He is the first character of the day to appear in {{aniseries|DP}}. Cheeves is part of the staff at James's second summer home in [[Sinnoh]]. Upon arriving after having a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{AP|Pikachu}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, and finding his {{TP|James|Carnivine}}, James summoned Cheeves with a food order for himself, [[Jessie]], and {{MTR}}. Once on the scene, however, Mr. Cheeves innocuously revealed that he had contacted [[James's parents]] about his arrival. As a result, they and [[Jessebelle]] would be arriving the next day, having expressed their eagerness to reunite with him. Consequently, it ruined {{TRT}}'s plans of making the summer home their base of operations in Sinnoh. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |en=Clyde Hunter |cs=Bohuslav Kalva |fi=Antti Jaakola |fr_eu=Benoît Van Dorslaer |it=Riccardo Rovatti |no=Even Rasmussen |pl=Janusz Wituch |pt_br=Dráuzio de Oliveira |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo}} ==Trivia== * As is the case with James's other butlers, [[Hopkins]] and {{OBP|Sebastian|DP153}}, Mr. Cheeves was unnamed in the Japanese version but was given a name in the dub. * Mr. Cheeves' name is likely a corruption of "Jeeves", the name of the valet from British author P.G. Wodehouse's ''{{wp|Jeeves}}'' series of novels and short stories; the name would become a generic one used to refer to valets and butlers.
